title: Search Channel Health
description: DISCOVER-stage gate artifact. Output of search-channel-auditor. Verifies every declared retrieval channel contributed, failure semantics are truthfully classed (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED/THROTTLED/AUTH/DOWN/PARSE), citation-chase receipts exist per seed when declared, harvests are checkpointed, and the records->deduped->papers->pool count chain is single-sourced. BLOCKs on: a declared channel with 0 yield and no named failure; a misassigned failure class; a declared chase arm with no receipts; an uncheckpointed multi-query harvest; two irreconcilable counts for one population. Failure-catalog items A1/A2/A5/A6/B1 (2026-08-20 team upgrade).
